children: Raymond will raise up to ₹214.71 crore through the preferential issue of 33,28,686 convertible warrants to Minerva Ventures Fund, according to a regulatory filing on Tuesday.

The warrants will be issued at ₹645 each, including a premium of ₹635, with the proceeds to be received in cash. Each warrant will entitle the investor to subscribe to one equity share of Raymond at ₹645 per share.
The company’s board approved the fundraise at its meeting held on September 8. The issue is subject to approval from the company’s members and other applicable regulatory approvals.
Minerva Ventures Fund to receive stake on conversion
Minerva Ventures Fund is the sole proposed investor in the issue. It currently does not hold any shares in Raymond.
If all the warrants are converted, the fund’s holding will amount to 33,28,686 shares, representing 4.35% of the company on a fully diluted basis, according to the filing.
The warrants can be converted into equity shares in one or more tranches within 18 months from the date of allotment. The company said the tenure of the warrants will not exceed 18 months.
The filing does not specify how the funds will be deployed by Raymond.

The investor will have to exercise its conversion rights within the specified 18-month period. Any warrants that remain unconverted after this period will lapse, and the amount paid towards those warrants will be forfeited.
The proposed issue forms part of a preferential allotment and will be made to a single investor.
Raymond reported a sharp sequential rise in net profit, which surged 1,758% to ₹21 crore in Q1 FY27 from ₹1.13 crore in Q4 FY26.

Revenue increased 0.4% quarter-on-quarter to ₹606 crore from ₹603 crore, while EBITDA rose 2.4% to ₹77.3 crore from ₹75.5 crore. EBITDA margin improved to 12.8% in Q1 FY27 from 12.5% in the previous quarter.
The company reported total income of ₹628 crore in the first quarter of FY27, registering 13% year-on-year growth compared with ₹555 crore in Q1 FY26.
Shares of the company closed at ₹856.85, up 10.93% from their previous close on Tuesday.

title: Raymond to raise ₹215 crore via preferential issue of warrants to Minerva Ventures Fund
